acceptance_criteria: Compose the existing Product Owner confirmation core behind a production first-party HTTPS service
Load deployment configuration strictly and fail before listening when protected configuration is unavailable
Use a deployable protected secret-provider boundary without Git or ordinary environment secrets
Persist bounded security audit evidence without tokens, secrets, nonces, or raw authentication material
Provide governed Keycloak realm/client/role/MFA provisioning templates with deployment-time placeholders only
Provide service startup artifacts and locator-only confirmation status without lifecycle mutation
Issue Approval Context only through the existing server-side issuer and preserve confirmation service authority
End in BLOCKED_PENDING_PROVISIONING after independent Architect PASS until administrator values are provisioned
prohibited_actions: Create or consume Product Owner decision evidence
Execute AIDP-INFRA-0005 or ordinary infrastructure work
Modify Approval Context nonce or Decision Journal
Weaken HTTPS, OIDC, MFA, CSRF, replay, or fail-closed controls
